decision.reason: Five default processes hit the 500-cycle cap without the required final 100 consecutive complete cycles free of a new HWM. All tracked lifecycle checks pass, but arena-retention attribution cannot waive the all-process plateau criterion.
decision.allocator_classification_limit: Concrete late events show existing anonymous glibc arenas expanding mainly as free retained capacity. In-use counters fluctuate and some comparable positions drift; exact application/library allocation ownership and fully stable live bytes are not proved. Do not claim RealLeak, AllocatorRetention or BoundedProcessCache for the campaign.
